title: Sonay Kartal's Comeback Reaches the Wuhan Semifinals
summary:
British tennis player Sonay Kartal is having an amazing comeback. The 24-year-old beat Elina Svitolina of Ukraine 6-2, 2-6, 6-4 at the Wuhan Open in China. Svitolina is ranked sixth in the world.

Kartal missed more than six months of tennis because of a stress fracture in her back. Her ranking dropped to 170. But since coming back, she has won six of her eight matches. Earlier in Wuhan, she also beat Jasmine Paolini and Belinda Bencic.

The match was close. Svitolina won the second set, but Kartal won the third set to take the match. "It's breaking new ground for me this week," Kartal said. She thanked the crowd for the great atmosphere.

Kartal is only the second British player, after Johanna Konta, to reach this kind of big semifinal since 2009. On Saturday, she will play Jeļena Ostapenko, who won the French Open in 2017.
why_it_matters: Kartal shows that athletes can come back strong after getting hurt if they keep working hard.
